steps.content:
PLAN
1. List the directory and repository map to understand the structure and locate the `src/tlv.c` and `src/tlv.h` files.
2. Read the `src/tlv.h` file to understand the structure of the `TlvDoc` and the function signatures.
3. Create a new file named `harness_fuzz.c` in the root of the repository.
4. Include the `src/tlv.h` header file in the `harness_fuzz.c` file.
5. Define the `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput` function, which will be the entry point for the fuzzer.
6. Declare a `TlvDoc` variable and call `tlv_parse` with the input data and size. If `tlv_parse` returns `TLV_OK`, call `tlv_free` to free the allocated memory.
7. Compile the harness using the command `clang -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined harness_fuzz.c src/tlv.c -I . -o /tmp/h`. If the compilation is successful, say "DONE". If it crashes, that is the win as it means your harness works.
